evidence.checked_design: Experiment 4: Two Were Left; normal narrative instructions versus identifying words/sentences difficult for fourth-grade readers; fiction versus historical-account labels.
evidence.checked_finding: Task reducing transportation also reduced story-consistent beliefs and positive character ratings; source-label effects not reliable.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Instruction manipulation supports a contribution of transportation; does not isolate every possible mediator. No assertion of universal fiction/nonfiction equivalence.

evidence.checked_design: Study 3; 159 campus participants donate from $5 payment; identifiable child, statistics, combined appeal.
evidence.checked_finding: Mean donations $2.38/$1.14/$1.43; child higher than each alternative, lower two not statistically distinguished.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: One donation task; giving is not the quality of resource allocation. Figure reports means, not individual observations or invented error bars.

evidence.checked_design: Experiments 1–3 manipulate text complexity; Experiment 4 manipulates font readability.
evidence.checked_finding: Needless complexity and difficult-to-read fonts reduce rated author intelligence.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Author-intelligence judgments, not actual intelligence or a universal benefit of simplifying technical ideas.
evidence.source_location: Publisher abstract; no novel numerical estimates introduced

evidence.checked_design: Five experiments, total N=5780, including BBC News field experiment; point estimate versus numerical/verbal uncertainty formats.
evidence.checked_finding: Disclosure increases perceived uncertainty; trust reductions small overall and concentrated in verbal formats; numerical ranges generally little penalty.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Responses to particular factual reports, not guarantee of durable relational trust; does not claim every numerical format has exactly zero effect.
evidence.source_location: Abstract; Experiment 1 methods and results; experiments 2–5 discussion

evidence.checked_design: Experimental online getting-acquainted chats; instruct more versus fewer questions.
evidence.checked_finding: More-question condition increased partner liking and perceived responsiveness.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Restrict rewritten claim to experiments; do not treat observational speed-dating association or follow-up classification as a universal causal rule. A later reanalysis raises problems with speed-dating interpretation.
evidence.source_location: Author institutional repository abstract; primary manuscript linked there

evidence.checked_design: Two studies of hypothetical accountant tax-return transgression; apology definitions/components and actual wording varied.
evidence.checked_finding: Explanation + acknowledgment of responsibility + offer of repair rated more effective than regret + repentance + forgiveness request.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Ratings of hypothetical apologies, not actual repair; no universal rank order of individual apology ingredients asserted.
evidence.source_location: Methods and discussion; EAO versus RDF comparisons

evidence.checked_design: Three buyer/seller negotiation experiments; first offer and recipient focus varied.
evidence.checked_finding: First offer benefits whichever side opens; focusing on opponent alternatives, reservation price, or own target eliminates advantage in respective experiments.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Controlled bargaining tasks; not a general rule to make an uninformed first offer.

evidence.checked_design: Two studies measure accuracy of counterpart-interest judgments and negotiation performance.
evidence.checked_finding: Many participants expect total opposition, overlook compatible interests; early accuracy associated with higher outcomes.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Accuracy–payoff association does not identify the causal effect of unrestricted disclosure. No unsupported percentages added.

evidence.checked_design: Six experiments comparing single and multiple equivalent simultaneous offers; experiment 1 packages generated at same offerer point value.
evidence.checked_finding: Economic and relational benefits across experiments; offer choices support recipient starting points, joint gains and perceived cooperativeness.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Structured negotiation tasks and package equivalence; no unconditional claim that all menus improve both parties’ outcomes.
evidence.source_location: Indexed primary PDF abstract/methods; Experiment 1 and general discussion

evidence.checked_design: Randomized workplace flu reminders; control N1268, date-and-time N1270 across same sites; date-only N734 limited to multiday sites.
evidence.checked_finding: Raw workplace vaccination 33.1% control versus 37.1% date/time: 4.0pp difference. Covariate-adjusted 4.2pp (95% CI0.5–7.8); date-only not significant.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Figure includes only comparable full-sample arms; does not mix date-only subgroup with all-site raw means. Outcome is vaccination at the workplace clinics.
evidence.source_location: Indexed full primary PDF Tables 1–2 and text; author PDF sometimes rejects direct open

evidence.checked_design: Field experiment; 877 survey responders from equally randomized recruitment groups; future gym calendar planning versus recalling prior visits.
evidence.checked_finding: No increase in administrative gym attendance; planned timing predicts actual attendance without a causal increase in visits.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Survey respondents and short horizon; do not interpret null as proof plans never help or as a direct randomized vaccination-versus-exercise comparison.

evidence.checked_design: Study 1 predicts other students’ semester GPAs from background/prior GPA with versus without an interview; random-response condition switches to question-letter rule after break.
evidence.checked_finding: Predictions correlate r=.31 with grades after interviews versus r=.61 without interviews; confidence/informativeness judgments not reliably different in random and truthful conditions.
evidence.interpretive_boundary: Not every employment interview; r=.61 is participant prediction without interview, distinct from r=.65 for prior GPA alone. Random-response condition described as starting during interview, not all 20 minutes.
